tip.title: Near future
tip.body: To say what you are going to do, use aller plus a verb. Je vais manger. Nous allons partir.

tip.title: In and ago
tip.body: Dans plus a time means in. Dans deux jours is in 2 days. Il y a deux jours is 2 days ago.

exercises.prompt: How do you say "can you come"?
Do you want to come to the park

tip.title: Want and can
tip.body: Vouloir and pouvoir are followed by a verb. Tu veux venir ? Tu peux venir ? To decline kindly, say désolé and offer une autre fois.

tip.title: Telling the time
tip.body: À quelle heure asks what time. À midi is exactly noon. Vers midi is around noon.
